_about: Curated supplement, hand-checked against the linked articles. American Revolution, 1763-1789, year by year and colony by colony. Merged with Wikidata events by Wikipedia title: Wikidata wins on description, this file fills missing day, place and colony. Coordinates are approximate (town level).

events.label: Treaty of Paris (1763)
events.desc: Ends the Seven Years' War; France gives up Canada and lands east of the Mississippi to Britain

events.label: Royal Proclamation of 1763
events.desc: King George III forbids colonial settlement west of the Appalachian divide

events.label: Stamp Act
events.desc: Parliament taxes printed paper in the colonies, sparking protests

events.label: Stamp Act Congress
events.desc: Delegates from nine colonies meet in New York to protest the Stamp Act

events.label: Townshend Acts
events.desc: Parliament taxes glass, lead, paint, paper and tea imported into the colonies

events.label: Boston Massacre
events.desc: British soldiers fire on a crowd in Boston, killing five people

events.label: Gaspee Affair
events.desc: Rhode Island colonists burn the British customs schooner Gaspee

events.label: Tea Act
events.desc: Parliament lets the East India Company sell tea directly to the colonies

events.label: Boston Tea Party
events.desc: Colonists dump 342 chests of East India Company tea into Boston Harbor

events.label: Boston Port Act (Intolerable Acts)
events.desc: Parliament closes Boston's port, the first of the acts colonists called Intolerable

events.label: Fairfax Resolves
events.desc: Fairfax County, Virginia, rejects Parliament's authority over the colonies

events.label: First Continental Congress
events.desc: Delegates from twelve colonies meet in Philadelphia and agree a boycott of British goods

events.label: Suffolk Resolves
events.desc: Suffolk County, Massachusetts, calls for resistance to the Intolerable Acts

events.label: Raid on Fort William and Mary
events.desc: New Hampshire militia seize gunpowder from the British fort at New Castle
events.wiki: Raid on Fort William and Mary

events.label: Battles of Lexington and Concord
events.desc: First fighting of the American Revolutionary War, near Boston

events.label: Siege of Boston begins
events.desc: Colonial militia surround British-held Boston; the siege lasts until March 1776

events.label: Capture of Fort Ticonderoga
events.desc: Ethan Allen and Benedict Arnold take the British fort on Lake Champlain

events.label: Second Continental Congress
events.desc: Congress meets again in Philadelphia and becomes the colonies' wartime government

events.label: Mecklenburg Resolves
events.desc: Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, declares British commissions void

events.label: Continental Army founded
events.desc: Congress creates the Continental Army and the next day names George Washington its commander

events.label: Battle of Bunker Hill
events.desc: British take the Charlestown heights at heavy cost

events.label: Olive Branch Petition
events.desc: Congress makes a last appeal to King George III to avoid war

events.label: Proclamation of Rebellion
events.desc: King George III declares the colonies to be in open rebellion

events.label: Battle of Great Bridge
events.desc: Virginia patriots defeat Lord Dunmore's forces near Norfolk

events.label: Battle of Quebec
events.desc: American attack on Quebec City fails; Richard Montgomery is killed

events.label: New Hampshire adopts a constitution
events.desc: New Hampshire becomes the first colony to set up its own government

events.label: Common Sense published
events.desc: Thomas Paine's pamphlet argues for independence and sells widely

events.label: Battle of Moore's Creek Bridge
events.desc: North Carolina patriots defeat Loyalist Highlanders

events.label: British evacuate Boston
events.desc: After cannon are placed on Dorchester Heights, the British leave Boston

events.label: Halifax Resolves
events.desc: North Carolina tells its delegates in Congress to vote for independence

events.label: Rhode Island renounces allegiance to the Crown
events.desc: Rhode Island's assembly is the first colony to renounce allegiance to King George III
events.wiki: Colony of Rhode Island and Providence Plantations

events.label: Virginia Declaration of Rights
events.desc: Virginia's convention adopts a declaration of rights drafted by George Mason

events.label: Battle of Sullivan's Island
events.desc: Charleston's defenders drive off a British fleet

events.label: Lee Resolution
events.desc: Congress votes that the colonies are free and independent states

events.label: Declaration of Independence
events.desc: Congress adopts the Declaration of Independence in Philadelphia

events.label: Battle of Long Island
events.desc: British defeat Washington's army in Brooklyn

events.label: Landing at Kip's Bay
events.desc: British land on Manhattan and take New York City

events.label: Maryland adopts a constitution
events.desc: Maryland's convention adopts its first state constitution

events.label: Battle of Trenton
events.desc: Washington crosses the Delaware and captures the Hessian garrison at Trenton

events.label: Battle of Princeton
events.desc: Washington defeats a British force at Princeton

events.label: Vermont declares independence
events.desc: Vermont declares itself an independent republic, separate from New York

events.label: Battle of Ridgefield
events.desc: Connecticut militia attack British troops returning from the raid on Danbury

events.label: Battle of Bennington
events.desc: New England militia destroy a detachment of Burgoyne's army

events.label: Battle of Cooch's Bridge
events.desc: The only significant battle of the war fought in Delaware

events.label: Battle of Brandywine
events.desc: British defeat Washington and open the road to Philadelphia

events.label: British occupy Philadelphia
events.desc: British troops march into Philadelphia; Congress has moved west

events.label: Battle of Germantown
events.desc: Washington's attack on the British camp at Germantown fails

events.label: Surrender at Saratoga
events.desc: General Burgoyne surrenders his army, a turning point of the war

events.label: Articles of Confederation adopted
events.desc: Congress, meeting in York, sends the Articles of Confederation to the states

events.label: Winter at Valley Forge
events.desc: The Continental Army sets up its winter camp at Valley Forge

events.label: Treaty of Alliance with France
events.desc: France and the United States sign a military alliance in Paris

events.label: Battle of Monmouth
events.desc: Long, hot battle in New Jersey ends without a clear winner

events.label: Battle of Wyoming
events.desc: Loyalists and Iroquois allies defeat Patriot militia in Pennsylvania's Wyoming Valley

events.label: Capture of Savannah
events.desc: British take Savannah, starting their southern campaign

events.label: Battle of Kettle Creek
events.desc: Patriot militia defeat Loyalists in the Georgia backcountry

events.label: Battle of Stony Point
events.desc: Anthony Wayne's light infantry storm the British post at night

events.label: Siege of Savannah
events.desc: French and American forces fail to retake Savannah

events.label: Fall of Charleston
events.desc: The American garrison surrenders Charleston, a major defeat

events.label: Battle of Camden
events.desc: British rout the southern American army under Horatio Gates

events.label: Battle of Kings Mountain
events.desc: Patriot militia destroy a Loyalist force on the Carolina border

events.label: Battle of Cowpens
events.desc: Daniel Morgan defeats Banastre Tarleton in South Carolina

events.label: Articles of Confederation take effect
events.desc: Maryland's ratification completes the first constitution of the United States

events.label: Battle of Guilford Court House
events.desc: Cornwallis wins the field but loses a quarter of his army

events.label: Battle of the Chesapeake
events.desc: A French fleet turns back the British navy, trapping Cornwallis at Yorktown

events.label: Battle of Groton Heights
events.desc: Benedict Arnold's raid burns New London and takes Fort Griswold

events.label: Surrender at Yorktown
events.desc: Cornwallis surrenders to Washington and Rochambeau, ending major fighting

events.label: Preliminary peace signed
events.desc: British and American negotiators sign preliminary peace articles in Paris

events.label: Treaty of Paris (1783)
events.desc: Britain recognises the independence of the United States

events.label: British evacuate New York City
events.desc: The last British troops leave New York City

events.label: Shays' Rebellion begins
events.desc: Indebted farmers close the court at Northampton, Massachusetts

events.label: Constitutional Convention opens
events.desc: Delegates meet in Philadelphia to replace the Articles of Confederation

events.label: Northwest Ordinance
events.desc: Congress organises the Northwest Territory and bans slavery there

events.label: United States Constitution signed
events.desc: Delegates sign the new constitution in Philadelphia

events.label: Delaware ratifies the Constitution
events.desc: Delaware becomes the first state to ratify the Constitution
events.wiki: History of the United States Constitution

events.label: New Hampshire ratifies the Constitution
events.desc: As the ninth state to ratify, New Hampshire puts the Constitution into effect
events.wiki: History of the United States Constitution

events.label: George Washington inaugurated
events.desc: Washington takes the oath as the first president at Federal Hall, New York
